messages:
elaine (marketing): Heads-up team 1 - we want to publish the Optimize 2.1 announcement on Tue 09:00 PT. Can engineering confirm changelog PR + public docs URL by Friday EOD? :calendar:
raj (eng): I can get the PR ready. will open changelog PR + bench summary by Thu AM. tagging @brooke for docs sync.
brooke (docs): I have a public draft ready; need the final performance numbers to finish the benchmark callout and the short API example.
mason (product): rollout preference: gradual canary (10%, 40%, 100%) over ~90 minutes. need the feature flag name and a safe rollback step. also want a single-line metric for the hero copy.
raj (eng): flag is optimize_2_1_enabled. rollout script below for ops:
```
./ops/deploy --feature optimize_2_1_enabled --stages 10,40,100 --pause 30m
```
raj (eng): I'll add a clear "breaking changes" section in the PR (even if "none") so support/legal can sign off.
sophie (growth): Webinar is set for Wed 10AM PT. If we have bench numbers by Thu, we'll include a 3-slide bench highlight in the invite and an animated snippet for socials. who will produce the 15s GIF?
brooke (docs): I can generate a quick GIF from the perf dashboard once the report is uploaded. pls confirm which graph we should use (latency p50 or cost per token).
mason (product): use latency p50 for the hero GIF, cost/tokens as an inset stat. also confirm if any config flags are user-facing.
raj (eng): no user-facing API changes. internal config renamed but no breaking user changes. adding "No breaking changes" line to PR now. full bench report (internal) will be uploaded to gs://redwood-bench/optimize-2-1 and linked from the PR later today.
brooke (docs): publishing plan: public doc URL will be https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-2-1 by Friday once we swap the draft. will paste final link here.
elaine (marketing): perfect. once links are here I'll prep the announcement post, hero copy, and social variants. tagging @sophie for webinar copy and @mason for the hero metric.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for Tue 08:00 PT for feature optimize_2_1_enabled  CI checks pending. :gear:
sophie (growth): sweet. when brooke posts the public docs link I'll update the webinar landing page and email copy. also will request design for the GIF this afternoon.
brooke (docs): public link now live: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-2-1 and changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/912. PR includes "~22% median latency improvement, ~10% lower token cost vs 2.0" callout.
elaine (marketing): thank you! I'll send a draft announcement Monday for review and lock the publish schedule. everyone, please add any final blockers by EOD Fri. :rocket:
